shop/ends

What it is
  = What is done as it stops, fails, or takes a new text.
  Keeps:
    items: `open`
  After a restart:
    title: Begun again from its start
  Runs:
    title: On, for what it hears
  Gives out:
    items: `thing`

What it makes
  Makes: [main/made]
    title: a thing called `shelf`
    made: a thing `shelf` (shelf)

What it does when it is applied
  Make sure a thing is there. [main/made]

What it hears, and what it then does
  `thing.changed`: a thing was changed [on.changed/@]
    from: Heard from its own project, and from the factory itself.
    Do nothing. [on.changed/run]

What it may do
  = It runs as whoever applies it, and can do no more than they can.
  Permissions:
    items: `things`
    items: `post`
  = Read things. [things:read]
  = Make and change things. [things:write]
  = Send letters. [post:send]

What it does as it ends or is changed
  = When its steps went well:
    ending: success
    Write a line in the run's log.
  = When its steps fail:
    ending: fail
    Send a letter.
  = When its steps have ended, however they went:
    ending: finish
    Write a line in the run's log.
  = When it takes a new text while it is running, in place of running its steps again:
    ending: update
    Keep `open`.
    Send a letter.
      only: Only when `version` of the instance as it was before this text is not `2`.
  = When it is stopped:
    ending: stop
    Read a thing.
